I'm checking why select("x") still returns the extra y column even though the projection should only keep x. My guess is that the pushdown keeps y for the predicate, and the simple-projection step then gets built against an output schema that no longer matches. I'll look at how the projected-name set is computed relative to the old and new schemas.

I'm going to check `ExprOrigin::get_column_origin` against the output names, and then look at `det_join_schema` for the left-join CrossAndFilter case.
